lines.text: Paul says each man should have his own wife and each woman her own husband, and couples may stop only by mutual consent for prayer.
Paul says couples should come together again after a time of prayer, so that Satan will not tempt them.
Paul gives the Lord's command that a wife must not separate from her husband, and if she does, she must remain unmarried or be reconciled.
Paul says it is good for the unmarried and widows to remain unmarried, but if they cannot control themselves, let them marry.
Paul says a slave called by the Lord is the Lord's freedman, and a free man called is Christ's slave.
